edinburgh_home_c_murray.text: Every August the Fringe fills the city. It began in 1947 and is now the biggest arts festival in the world. I have been in the audience for nine shows and a street juggler.
Wheesht! Which is Scots for hush. My wee brother is rehearsing his own juggling.

then.text: That is the lot for today, I am afraid. Mind how you go.

else.text: Here, take some cranachan, toasted oats, cream and raspberries. Mum makes it. I only eat it.
